subject: Greenpath go/no-go synthesis + post-deploy smoke pack
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, samir.patel@greenpath.health
Cc: elena.morozova@bigbank.com
Date: 2027-04-25T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenpath pre-cutover summary + evidence requested

Team / Samir,

We have the go/no-go call at 18:00 PT. This thread is the single source for final evidence and outstanding gating items. Please paste short evidence stubs (log excerpts, timestamps, link to artifact) rather than full files. Attachments referenced below.

Minimum acceptance (must be met before 21:00 cutover):
- Networking: BGP advertised routes present in both DCs, ACLs allow 10.1.0.0/16 -> 10.2.0.0/16 for management plane, and customer VPC peering established.
- Serving: KV cache primed for top-50 prefixes (see kv-warmup list); continuous batching turned on for private model variant.
- Observability: 95p tail latency < 350ms on synthetic generators for 30m window; error rate < 0.5% 5xx.
- Rollback: documented rollback plan (steps + expected duration) and smoke rollback verification pass.
- Security/compliance: audit logging enabled, KMS key binding tested for one encryption case.

Attachments/links: runbook-checklist-v1.3.pdf (attached), go/no-go doc (Drive link), provisioning CSV.

Ask: each owner reply with a one-paragraph status + evidence line by 11:30 PT. If any item is red, mark clearly and propose mitigation.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment stub: runbook-checklist-v1.3.pdf]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.patel@greenpath.health
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenpath pre-cutover summary + evidence requested

On 2027-04-25 08:12, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
> Team / Samir,
>
> We have the go/no-go call at 18:00 PT....

Quick status from networking/serving side:
- BGP / Peering: Both DCs advertising routes to Greenpath. BGP TTL/neighbor flaps cleared at 09:42 (see bgp-notes).
- ACLs: Verified allow rules for management and customer subnets via config-diff; sample: acl-rule-173 matches expected.
- KV cache: Warmup executed for top-50 prefixes — warmed entries count: 49/50 (missing prefix 10.1.42.0/24 due to stale feed). Will repush feed at 12:15 (expected to complete <10m). Evidence: smoke-evidence-ops.log (attached) contains kv-warmup completion timestamps.
- Serving variant: batching enabled with max_latency=20ms; initial throughput test: 500 qps sustained for 15m with 95p=290ms.
- KMS: test encryption/decryption OK for sample VM.

Open risk: missing one prefix for kv-warmup (low severity) and minor firewall session timeout observed between DCs (short spikes at 09:41-09:44). Monitoring alert threshold adjusted and will be watched during canary.

Attachments: smoke-evidence-ops.log, vm-provisioning.csv

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
[attachment stub: smoke-evidence-ops.log]

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.patel@greenpath.health
Date: 2027-04-25T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenpath pre-cutover summary + evidence requested

Thanks Vivek — good detail. Operational gating items:
- Observability: Synthetic generator running since 11:05 PT; 30m window will finish 11:35 — initial 15m checks show 95p=320ms, errors 0.18%. Full 30m will be posted to the Drive link.
- Alerts: Pager rota confirmed (Karthik on-call primary, Marissa backup). Alert runbook verified in confluence (link below).
- Canary: plan to run a 30-minute canary on 2 racks (10% traffic) starting 19:10 PT. Canary thresholds: 95p latency < 360ms, 5xx < 0.7%, drop-in success >= 99.3%.
- Rollback rehearsal: I exercised the rollback plan in the staging replica at 10:00 PT — expected rollback time 18-22 minutes including DNS and cache purge; steps in runbook-checklist-v1.3.pdf.

If synthetic completes clean, I will mark observability as green.

Irene Choi
Senior Engineering Manager, Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.patel@greenpath.health
Date: 2027-04-25T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenpath pre-cutover summary + evidence requested

Readouts look solid. My recommendation: proceed with cutover tonight at 21:00 PT with the following constraints to reduce blast radius:
- Canary at 19:10 as planned, if pass then proceed to 40% at 21:00 and full ramp by 22:15 only if no regressions.
- Disable aggressive batching for first 30 minutes post-cutover (keep continuous batching but lower batch size cap) to avoid queue build-up in edge failure cases.
- Holdback: keep the last commit of the config repo pinned for 90m so we can quickly backstop to previous config if needed.
- Finance/credits: leadership approved a 1-week service credit holdback if any SLO breach occurs in first 48h.

I'll be on the bridge for the canary and the main window. Karthik will run rollback steps in parallel if needed.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: samir.patel@greenpath.health
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.morozova@bigbank.com
Date: 2027-04-25T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenpath pre-cutover summary + evidence requested

Thanks for the thorough thread. Greenpath is provisionally ok with the timeline. Two small asks from our side before final go:
1) Can you confirm the firewall session timeout spike was observed only within the narrow window and not persistent?
2) Please add one more synthetic test across our EU peering link (we saw different latencies in staging).

If those two items are documented as low-risk and watched during canary, we sign off for the 21:00 cutover.

Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Greenpath Health

Karthik Iyer

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.patel@greenpath.health, elena.morozova@bigbank.com
Date: 2027-04-25T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final synthesis: green + cutover plan

All — thanks for the quick turn. Synthesis: observability synth completed with full 30m window (95p=325ms), KV warmup repushed at 12:15 and now shows 50/50 prefixes warmed. Firewall session spike isolated to a 3-minute maintenance overlap and will be watched. EU synthetic run scheduled and owned by Karthik.

Decision: GREEN.
- Canary: 19:10 PT, 10% traffic, 30m.
- Cutover start: 21:00 PT — 40% initial ramp, observe 30m, then progressive ramp to 100% by 22:15 if stable.
- Bridge: Zoom invite + pager channel in Slack (links in Drive doc). On-call and execs will be present; contact numbers in runbook.

Attachments: runbook-checklist-v1.3.pdf, smoke-evidence-ops.log, vm-provisioning.csv. I will post the final post-cutover validation checklist and a short evidence bundle within 1 hour of cutover completion.

If anyone sees a new red item before 19:00, call it out here ASAP.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment stubs: runbook-checklist-v1.3.pdf, smoke-evidence-ops.log, vm-provisioning.csv]
